topic: How does antenna design influence the accuracy of encrypted traffic classification systems in heterogeneous satellite networks?
consensus_response: Antenna design significantly impacts encrypted traffic classification accuracy by influencing signal quality through array complexity, polarization management, and frequency selection. Phased arrays with reconfigurable elements and beamforming algorithms enhance SNR, reducing interference and improving ML model performance.
reference_context: Polarization correlation coefficients vary by environment, affecting signal clarity and classification accuracy.
